claim_boundary: This decision applies only to the tested analytical correctness scale and does not claim that RL can never help on larger or nonstationary networks.
decision: RL research is authorized because at least one quantitative gate passed.

A_performance_gap.threshold: >5% median B6 disadvantage against regret-feasible B4 in at least 2 scenario families

B_runtime.threshold: >5 seconds in more than 20% of focused recommendation cycles

C_dynamic_generalization.reason: no trained policy exists and drift evidence is unit-level, not a full traffic study
C_dynamic_generalization.threshold: >10% degradation under a pre-registered nonstationary environment

D_feedback_instability.reason: accepted one-way route changes are not counted as feedback oscillation
D_feedback_instability.threshold: >0.25 back-and-forth route reversals per user per step in at least 2 families

E_scalability.reason: focused study is a 6-user correctness scale; large-scale solver evidence is absent
E_scalability.threshold: >5 seconds at the declared operational scale
